messages.subject: Re: Problem with the installation
messages.body_plain:
You can open R and use the Installer from the R menu to install the Deducer package plus its Dependencies (tick that box) from a CRAN mirror as a binary.
That works well.

messages.subject: Re: Windows 10 Problem? Error in .jcall
messages.body_plain:
This sounds like a problem with rJava, a dependency of Deducer. The rJava version must match your R version and Deducer version and also be compatible with the oracle java version installed.
For instance, oracle java jdk 11, R 3.5.3 , rJava 0.9-11 and Deducer 0.7-9  is a good match.

messages.subject: Re: Deducer installer for R 3.4 version
messages.body_plain:
Deducer 0.7-9 is still working ok, including with the latest release of R, R 3.6.0.

But version specific matching java support, namely oracle java, rJava and R version is required. There are some severe incompatibilities. So, make sure these are all matching, no mix up here.

Deducer is not the problem, java is the tricky part.

messages.subject: Re: Windows 10 Problem? Error in .jcall
messages.body_plain:
I was able to resolve this error by luck through loading the JGR package and running the command line "JGR()". I then went to package manager and set both loaded and default for the Deducer package. I no longer receive the error message when I run the command line "JGR()" within Deducer or in the JGR package.
